title: Classification of invariant curve pencils in type A bow varieties
author: Alexander Foster; Yiyan Shou
difficulty_reason: The construction must realize every tangent-weight multiplicity by geometrically stable surgery or nonsurgery curves, prove their independent pencil generation, and exhaust the residual weights through matched-block induction. The stability constraint and surplus/deficit correction are essential; the final combinatorial induction alone is not separated from its geometric core.
